result.instructions: Tools for Elasticsearch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is our production Elasticsearch cluster healthy, and are any shards unassigned?"; "Which indices grew the most this week, and how many documents does each hold?"; "Find the last 20 error logs from the checkout service and group them by message.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Elasticsearch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run elasticsearch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run elasticsearch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run elasticsearch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. elasticsearch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_info
tools.title: Cluster info
tools.description: Get the cluster name, node name, and Elasticsearch version of this cluster. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /.

tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health
tools.title: Cluster health
tools.description: Get cluster health status (green, yellow, red), node and shard counts, and unassigned shards. API: GET /_cluster/health.

tools.name: elasticsearch_cluster_stats
tools.title: Cluster stats
tools.description: Get cluster-wide statistics: document and store totals, node count, JVM memory, and versions. API: GET /_cluster/stats.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_nodes
tools.title: List nodes
tools.description: List cluster nodes with roles, heap and disk usage, CPU, and load. API: GET /_cat/nodes (format=json).

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_indices
tools.title: List indices
tools.description: List indices with health, status, document count, store size, and shard counts. Optional name pattern. API: GET /_cat/indices (format=json).

index.description: Index name or wildcard pattern, e.g. logs-*. Omit to list all.

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_index
tools.title: Get an index
tools.description: Get an index's settings, mappings, and aliases in one call. API: GET /{index}.

index.description: Index, alias or data stream name. Comma lists and wildcards work, e.g. logs-*.

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_mapping
tools.title: Get field mappings
tools.description: Get the field mappings (field names and types) of an index, alias or data stream. Read this before writing a search query. API: GET /{index}/_mapping.

index.description: Index, alias or data stream name. Comma lists and wildcards work, e.g. logs-*.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_aliases
tools.title: List aliases
tools.description: List index aliases and the indices they point to. API: GET /_alias or GET /_alias/{name}.

name.description: Name or wildcard pattern. Omit to list all.

tools.name: elasticsearch_list_data_streams
tools.title: List data streams
tools.description: List data streams with their backing indices, generation, and status. API: GET /_data_stream or GET /_data_stream/{name}.

name.description: Name or wildcard pattern. Omit to list all.

tools.name: elasticsearch_search
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search documents in one or more indices with a Query DSL object. Returns hits, total count, and optional aggregations. Use elasticsearch_get_mapping first to learn the field names. API: POST /{index}/_search.

index.description: Index, alias or data stream name. Comma lists and wildcards work, e.g. logs-*.

query.description: Elasticsearch Query DSL object, e.g. {"match": {"title": "invoice"}}. Omit to match all documents.

size.description: Number of hits to return (0-100, default 10).

source_fields.description: Only return these fields of each document (_source filter).

tools.name: elasticsearch_count
tools.title: Count documents
tools.description: Count the documents that match a Query DSL object in one or more indices. API: POST /{index}/_count.

index.description: Index, alias or data stream name. Comma lists and wildcards work, e.g. logs-*.

query.description: Elasticsearch Query DSL object, e.g. {"match": {"title": "invoice"}}. Omit to match all documents.

tools.name: elasticsearch_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document by index and id. Optional source_fields limits the returned fields. API: GET /{index}/_doc/{id}.

index.description: Index or alias that holds the document.

routing.description: Routing value, if the document was indexed with one.

tools.name: elasticsearch_esql_query
tools.title: Run an ES|QL query
tools.description: Run a read-only ES|QL query, e.g. 'FROM logs-* | WHERE status >= 500 | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY service | LIMIT 20'. Returns columns and rows. API: POST /_query.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Elasticsearch
prompts.description: What you can do with Elasticsearch here, with example requests to try.
